title: Stabilization of isogeny spaces between supersingular Drinfeld modules
summary: Let $\mathfrak{p}$ be a prime of degree $d$ in $A = \mathbb{F}_q[T]$ and let $φ, ψ$ be supersingular Drinfeld modules of rank $r \geq 2$ in $A$-characteristic $\mathfrak{p}$. We study the $\mathbb{F}_q$-dimension of the space $M_s(φ, ψ) = \{u \in \mathrm{Hom}(φ, ψ) : \mathrm{deg}_τu \leq s\}$ as a function of $s$.
